purpose: Expose project-scoped durable campaign choices in authenticated Environment entry errors without changing entry authority.

authorization.basis: User authorized the narrow Control change for project-scoped campaign lookup and continuation.

behavior: Only project-scoped grants whose principal matches the authenticated Environment service are eligible.
Only campaign-continuation-ambiguous, campaign-context-mismatch, and campaign-session-active entry errors receive a supplementary read-only lookup.
Lookup is bound to the granted project repository and campaign identity returned by Environment diagnostics, when present.
Continuation rows are compacted and bounded; lookup failure is reported as unknown without converting the failed entry into success.
Environment remains authoritative for session selection and all mutations.

restricted_environment.client: Project-scoped Bwrap execution with network disabled.
restricted_environment.filesystem_boundary: The Bwrap client does not receive direct Store path access.
restricted_environment.continuation_source: The integration test uses a deterministic campaign-capsule fixture; it verifies request binding, error propagation, bounded projection, and session-resume behavior through the real Bwrap client and RPC server.

readiness.canonical_store_acceptance: This change adds no Store authority or filesystem access. Canonical Store continuity evidence remains in the separate Environment evidence records.
readiness.remaining_limit: The new ambiguous-entry Bwrap test uses a deterministic capsule provider, so it does not independently re-prove live lookup over every canonical campaign record.
